name: FestivalAttendance

custom.system_prompt: You are generating calendar management conversations.

initial_prompt: Create a conversation between two people trying to coordinate their schedules for an upcoming event with help from a digital assistant.

setting.mood: Excited and energetic with underlying urgency
setting.relationship_dynamic: Group of close friends planning a multi-day festival experience together
setting.background: They must align time off work, transportation, accommodation check-ins, and the festival performance schedule

scenario_template.topic: Choosing which festival days to attend
scenario_template.note: They compare must-see performances and personal availability
They discover work shifts and transport schedules don't align
Users ask for help in planning by weighing various trade-offs
Assistant suggests best arrival times, show selections, and accommodation check-in windows
They decide which performances to sacrifice for a realistic schedule
Assistant sets calendar entries with travel buffers
They look forward to the event

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Career-focused individual with multiple professional commitments but passionate about making time for international travel and cultural experiences

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Freelancer with flexible but unpredictable work schedule who needs to balance project deadlines with personal time and values advanced planning

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Calendar management assistant that helps analyze schedule conflicts, propose optimal meeting times, and create calendar events with appropriate reminders and travel buffers
